words.tr: adj. 好的；优秀的；
words.ex: She is a good student.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个好学生。
words.en: Something that is good is of a high quality, standard, or level.

words.tr:
adv. 好；对；满意地；
int. （用于表示惊讶，疑虑，接受等）好；
n. 井；
adj. 健康的；
words.ex: She sings well.
words.ex_cn: 她唱得很好。
words.en: In a good or satisfactory manner; in a thorough manner; in a manner that is appropriate or suitable.

words.tr: adj. 更好的；更优秀的；“good”的比较级； adv. 更好地；“well”的比较级； v. 胜过；使更佳；
words.ex: This shirt is better than the other one.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫比那件更好。
words.en: If something is better, it is of a higher standard, quality, or level than something else, or than it was before.

words.tr:
adj. 最好的；
adv. 最好地；
n. 最佳物；佼佼者；最高水平；
words.ex: He is the best player on the team.
words.ex_cn: 他是队里最好的球员。
words.en: Of the most excellent, effective, or desirable type or quality.

words.tr: n. （非标准拼写）可能指 'badillo' 或类似名称，但无明确通用释义。若为特定人名或地名，则需具体语境解释。
words.ex: He used a badill to dig in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他用一把铲子在花园里挖土。
words.en: Of poor quality or not good; ill can also mean sick or unwell.

words.tr: adj. 更坏的；更糟糕的；“bad”的比较级； adv. 更糟；更坏；
words.ex: The weather got worse after noon.
words.ex_cn: 下午之后天气变得更坏了。
words.en: Comparative of bad : more unpleasant, difficult, or severe than before or than something else that is also bad

words.tr:
adj. 最坏的；最糟糕的；
n. 最坏的事；
words.ex: This is the worst day of my life.
words.ex_cn: 这是我生命中最糟糕的一天。
words.en: Superlative of bad: of the lowest quality, or the most unpleasant, difficult, or severe

words.tr:
adj. 许多的；
pron. 许多人或物；
words.ex: Many students like to play soccer after school.
words.ex_cn: 许多学生喜欢放学后踢足球。
words.en: A large number of.

words.tr:
adv. 非常地；
adj. 多；许多；
pron. 许多；
words.ex: She is much happier now.
words.ex_cn: 她现在快乐多了。
words.en: A large amount or to a great degree.

words.tr:
adv. 更加；
adj. 更多的；
pron. 更多的人或物；
words.ex: She wants to learn more about science.
words.ex_cn: 她想更深入了解科学。
words.en: You use 'more' to indicate that there is a greater amount of something than before or than average, or than something else. You can use 'more' with a noun to indicate that there is a greater amount of it than before or than average, or than something else.

words.tr:
adv. 最；
pron. 大部分；
adj. 最多的；大多数的；
words.ex: He is most tired after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后最累。
words.en: You use most to refer to the majority of a group of things or people or the largest part of something.

words.tr: adj. 少的；小的；
words.ex: There is little water left in the bottle.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里剩下的水很少。
words.en: Small in size, amount, or degree (often used to convey an appealing diminutiveness or express an affectionate or dismissive attitude).

words.tr: adv. 较少地；更少地；“little”的比较级； adj. 更少的；“little”的比较级； pron. 较少；更少；
words.ex: He eats less sugar now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在吃得更少的糖。
words.en: You use less to indicate that there is a smaller amount of something than before or than average. You can use 'less' to indicate that something is smaller in size or degree than another thing.

words.tr:
adv. 最小；最少；
adj. 最少的；最小的；
n. 最小；最少；
words.ex: He ran the least among all the runners.
words.ex_cn: 他在所有跑步者中跑得最少。
words.en: You use least to indicate that something is the smallest in amount, degree, or size, or the lowest in importance.

words.tr:
adv. 远；极；
adj. 较远的；遥远的；
words.ex: He ran far from the house.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得离房子很远。
words.en: At, to, or by a great distance (used to indicate the extent to which one thing is distant from another).

words.tr: adv. 更远地；“far”的比较级； adj. 更远的；“far”的比较级；
words.ex: He ran farther than his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得比他弟弟更远。
words.en: At or to a greater distance or more advanced point.

words.tr:
adv. 进一步；更远；此外；
adj. 更多的；附加的；
v. 促进；
words.ex: He explained the problem, and then gave further examples.
words.ex_cn: 他解释了这个问题，然后给出了进一步的例子。
words.en: to a greater degree or extent

words.tr:
adv. 最远地；最大限度地；“far”的最高级 
adj. 最远的；最大限度的；“far”的最高级
words.ex: He ran the farthest in the race.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中跑得最远。
words.en: At the greatest distance from a particular point, especially from the center or from you.

words.tr: adv. 最远地；最大限度地；
words.ex: He ran the furthest of all the students.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得比所有学生都远。
words.en: Furthest means at the greatest distance from a particular point or place.

words.tr: adj. 老的；旧的；年老的；
words.ex: The old man walks slowly in the park.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人在公园里慢慢走路。
words.en: Having lived or existed for a long time; no longer young or new.

words.tr: adj. 更老的；更旧的；更年老的；“old”的比较级；
words.ex: My older brother works as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 我哥哥年纪更大一些，是一名老师。
words.en: Comparative of old; having lived or existed for a longer time; more aged.

words.tr: adj. 最老的；最旧的；最年老的；
words.ex: He is the oldest person in his family.
words.ex_cn: 他是家里最年长的人。
words.en: The superlative form of 'old', used to describe someone or something that is the most aged or has existed the longest among a group.

words.tr: adj. 大的
words.ex: He is a big boy now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在是个大男孩了。
words.en: Of considerable size or extent; larger than other items of its kind.

words.tr: adj. 更大的；“big”的比较级；
words.ex: This box is bigger than that one.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子比那个大。
words.en: Comparative form of big: larger in size, amount, or degree than something else.

words.tr: adj.最大的【形容词big的最高级】
words.ex: This is the biggest apple I have ever seen.
words.ex_cn: 这是我见过的最大的苹果。
words.en: Of the greatest size or extent; largest.

words.tr: adj. 小的
words.ex: He has a small dog.
words.ex_cn: 他有一只小狗。
words.en: If something is small, it is not large in size or amount.

words.tr: adj. 更小的；“small”的比较级；
words.ex: This box is smaller than that one.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子比那个更小。
words.en: Smaller is the comparative form of small, meaning more little in size, amount, degree, or importance.

words.tr: adj. 小的；
words.ex: This is the smallest apple in the basket.
words.ex_cn: 这是篮子里最小的苹果。
words.en: The superlative form of 'small', meaning the least in size or amount.

words.tr: adj. 高的
words.ex: He is a tall man.
words.ex_cn: 他是个高个子男人。
words.en: If something is tall, it is higher than usual or than other things of its type.

words.tr: adj. 高的；（用以表示或询问高度）有…高；高的( tall的比较级 )；
words.ex: Tom is taller than his brother.
words.ex_cn: 汤姆比他哥哥高。
words.en: Comparative form of tall: of more than average height.

words.tr: adj.最高的（tall的最高级）
words.ex: He is the tallest boy in his class.
words.ex_cn: 他是班上最高的男孩。
words.en: The superlative form of 'tall', meaning having the greatest height among others.

words.tr: adj. 短的；矮的；
words.ex: He has short hair.
words.ex_cn: 他头发很短。
words.en: If something is short, it measures a small distance from one end to the other.

words.tr: adj. 更短的；更矮的；“short”的比较级；
words.ex: This rope is shorter than that one.
words.ex_cn: 这根绳子比那根更短。
words.en: Comparative of short: having a small distance from one end to the other.

words.tr: adj. 最短的；
words.ex: This is the shortest path to the school.
words.ex_cn: 这是到学校的最短路径。
words.en: Superlative form of 'short', meaning having the least length or duration.

words.tr:
adj. 长时间的；长的；
adv. 始终；长久地；
n. 长期；长时间；
v. 盼望；渴望；
words.ex: We had a long meeting yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨天开了一个长时间的会议。
words.en: Having a great distance from one end to the other; extending over a large area.

words.tr: adv. 更长久地；“long”的比较级； adj. 更长的；更长时间的；“long”的比较级；
words.ex: He stayed longer to finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他多待了一会儿来完成作业。
words.en: Comparative form of long: extending for a greater distance or time.

words.tr: adj. 长的；长时间的；
words.ex: This is the longest river in the country.
words.ex_cn: 这是这个国家最长的河流。
words.en: Superlative form of long: having the greatest length.

words.tr: adj. 年轻的；年幼的；
words.ex: The young boy plays soccer every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 这个年轻的孩子每天下午都踢足球。
words.en: Someone who is young has not lived for very long or is not yet mature.

words.tr: adj. 更年轻的；更年幼的；“young”的比较级；
words.ex: My younger brother likes to play soccer.
words.ex_cn: 我弟弟喜欢踢足球。
words.en: A younger person is someone who is not as old as another person or who is in the earlier part of their life.

words.tr:
adj. 年幼的；
n. 最小的儿子；
words.ex: He is the youngest in his family.
words.ex_cn: 他是家里最小的。
words.en: The youngest person in a group is the one who was born last and is therefore the least old.

words.tr: adj. 新的
words.ex: He bought a new bike yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天买了一辆新自行车。
words.en: Recently made, invented, introduced, or discovered; not existing before.

words.tr: adj. 更新的；较新的；
words.ex: This phone is newer than my old one.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机比我的旧手机更新。
words.en: Comparative form of 'new'; more recent or modern.

words.tr: adj. 最新的；
words.ex: This is the newest phone on the market.
words.ex_cn: 这是市场上最新的手机。
words.en: The most recent or latest; just out.

words.tr:
adv. 迅速；
adj. 快的；迅速的；
words.ex: He runs fast.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快。
words.en: Moving or capable of moving at high speed.

words.tr: adv.更快地（fast的比较级）
words.ex: He runs faster than his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得比他弟弟快。
words.en: Comparative of fast: moving or capable of moving at high speed.

words.tr: adj. 快的( fast的最高级 )；
words.ex: He is the fastest runner in the school.
words.ex_cn: 他是学校里跑得最快的人。
words.en: Superlative form of fast, meaning moving or capable of moving at high speed.

words.tr:
adj. 缓慢的；迟钝的；
v. 使减速；
words.ex: The slow car moved across the bridge.
words.ex_cn: 那辆缓慢的车驶过桥。
words.en: Moving or capable of moving only at a low speed; not fast.

words.tr: adj. 更慢的；更缓的；
words.ex: The slower car reached the finish line last.
words.ex_cn: 那辆更慢的车最后到达了终点。
words.en: Moving or happening at a lower speed than something else.

words.tr: adj. 最慢的
words.ex: He is the slowest runner in the class.
words.ex_cn: 他是班里跑得最慢的人。
words.en: The superlative form of 'slow', meaning the least quick or taking the most time.

words.tr:
adj. 高的；
adv. 在高处；
words.ex: The mountain is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这座山很高。
words.en: If something is high, it is a long way above the ground, above sea level, or above a particular point.

words.tr: adj. 更高的；高等级的；“high”的比较级； adv. 在更高处；“high”的比较级；
words.ex: He got a higher score than his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他比他的朋友得分更高。
words.en: Higher is the comparative form of 'high', meaning at or to a greater level or degree.

words.tr: adj.最高的（high的最高级）
words.ex: He got the highest score in the class.
words.ex_cn: 他在班上得了最高分。
words.en: Of the most elevated position or degree; utmost.

words.tr:
adj. 低沉的；低垂的；
adv. 低；低矮；在低处；往下地；
words.ex: He spoke in a low voice to avoid waking the baby.
words.ex_cn: 他用低沉的声音说话，以免吵醒婴儿。
words.en: If something is low, it is close to the ground, the bottom, or the base of something.

words.tr: adj. 较低的；下游的；“low”的比较级； v. 降低；
words.ex: He sat in the lower row of the theater.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在剧院的较低一排。
words.en: If you lower something, you move it slowly downwards. If you lower something, you make it less in amount, degree, value, or quality.

words.tr: adj. 最低的；最小的；
words.ex: The lowest temperature was recorded at night.
words.ex_cn: 最低温度是在夜间记录的。
words.en: Lowest means the smallest in size, amount, degree, or intensity. It is the superlative form of 'low'.

words.tr: adj. 便宜的；廉价的；
words.ex: This shirt is cheap and nice.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫又便宜又好看。
words.en: If something is cheap, it costs less money than usual or than you expected.

words.tr: adj. 更便宜的；“cheap”的比较级；
words.ex: This shirt is cheaper than that one.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫比那件更便宜。
words.en: Comparative form of cheap: costing less money than something else or than is usual.

words.tr: adj. 最便宜的；
words.ex: This store sells the cheapest apples in town.
words.ex_cn: 这家店卖城里最便宜的苹果。
words.en: The least expensive option available.

words.tr: adj. 昂贵的
words.ex: The phone is expensive.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机很贵。
words.en: Costing a lot of money; having a high price.

words.tr: phrase. 更昂贵的；价格更高的
words.ex: This phone is more expensive than that one.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机比那部更贵。
words.en: Comparative of 'expensive'; costing more money.

words.tr: phrase. 最昂贵的；最花钱的；价格最高的
words.ex: This is the most expensive phone in the store.
words.ex_cn: 这是店里最贵的手机。
words.en: Superlative form of expensive, meaning costing the most money.

words.tr: adj. 容易的；轻松的；
words.ex: This math problem is easy.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学题很容易。
words.en: If a job or action is easy, you can do it without difficulty because it is not complicated and causes no problems.

words.tr: adj. 更容易的；更简单的；“easy”的比较级；
words.ex: This math problem is easier than the last one.
words.ex_cn: 这个数学问题比上一个更容易。
words.en: comparative form of easy: less difficult or requiring less effort.

words.tr: adj. 容易的；
words.ex: This is the easiest math problem.
words.ex_cn: 这是最容易的数学题。
words.en: The superlative form of 'easy', meaning the least difficult or requiring the least effort.

words.tr: adj. 困难的
words.ex: This math problem is difficult.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学题很难。
words.en: Something that is difficult is not easy to do, understand, or deal with.

words.tr: phrase. 更困难的；更棘手的；更复杂的
words.ex: This math problem is more difficult than the last one.
words.ex_cn: 这个数学题比上一个更难。
words.en: Harder or more challenging than something else.

words.tr: phrase. 最困难的；最艰难的；最复杂的
words.ex: This math problem is the most difficult I have ever seen.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学题是我见过的最难的。
words.en: Superlative form of difficult, meaning requiring the most effort or skill.

words.tr: adj. 快乐的；高兴的；
words.ex: The child is happy when he plays with his toys.
words.ex_cn: 当孩子玩玩具时，他很快乐。
words.en: If you are happy, you are feeling or showing pleasure or contentment.

words.tr: adj. 感到（或显得）幸福的；幸福的( happy的比较级 )；
words.ex: She feels happier after talking to her friend.
words.ex_cn: 她和朋友聊完后感觉更幸福了。
words.en: Comparative form of happy. Feeling or showing pleasure or contentment.

words.tr: adj. 最快乐的；最幸福的；
words.ex: He is the happiest boy in the class.
words.ex_cn: 他是班上最快乐的男孩。
words.en: Superlative form of 'happy', meaning the most joyful or content.

words.tr: adj. 伤心的；难过的；
words.ex: He felt sad when his dog ran away.
words.ex_cn: 当他的狗跑掉时，他感到伤心。
words.en: Feeling or showing sorrow; unhappy.

words.tr: adj. 更悲伤的
words.ex: After hearing the news, he looked even sadder than before.
words.ex_cn: 听到这个消息后，他看起来比以前更悲伤了。
words.en: Comparative form of sad; feeling or showing sorrow; unhappy.

words.tr: adj. 最悲伤的；最令人难过的（sad 的最高级形式）
words.ex: That was the saddest movie I ever saw.
words.ex_cn: 那是我看过最悲伤的电影。
words.en: Superlative form of sad, meaning feeling or expressing the most sorrow.

words.tr: adj. 热的
words.ex: The soup is hot.
words.ex_cn: 汤是热的。
words.en: Having a high degree of heat or a high temperature.

words.tr: adj. 热的；热烈的；热的( hot的比较级 )；
words.ex: This summer is hotter than last year.
words.ex_cn: 今年夏天比去年更热。
words.en: Comparative form of 'hot', meaning having a high degree of heat or a high temperature.

words.tr: adj. 最热的；
words.ex: This summer is the hottest on record.
words.ex_cn: 今年夏天是有记录以来最热的。
words.en: Superlative form of 'hot', meaning having the highest temperature or being the most intense or popular.

words.tr:
adj. 寒冷的；冰冷的；
n. 寒冷；
words.ex: The cold wind made me shiver.
words.ex_cn: 寒冷的风让我发抖。
words.en: Something that is cold has a low temperature, especially when compared to the temperature of the human body. It can also describe a lack of warmth in someone's behavior or a situation.

words.tr: adj.cold（寒冷的）的比较级形式
words.ex: The weather is colder today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天气更冷了。
words.en: Comparative form of cold; having a lower temperature.

words.tr: adj. 最冷的
words.ex: Winter is the coldest season.
words.ex_cn: 冬天是最冷的季节。
words.en: Superlative form of 'cold', meaning having the lowest temperature or being the least warm.

words.tr:
adj. 温暖的；
v. （使）变暖；
words.ex: The sun gives us warm light.
words.ex_cn: 太阳给我们温暖的光。
words.en: Having or giving out a moderate degree of heat, as perceived by the senses.

words.tr: adj. 暖和的； n. 使热的人，温热装置 adj. 暖和的( warm的比较级 )；
words.ex: This jacket is warmer than the other one.
words.ex_cn: 这件夹克比那件更暖和。
words.en: Something that is warmer has a higher temperature than something else, or than it had before.

words.tr: adj. 最温暖的
words.ex: This is the warmest coat I have ever worn.
words.ex_cn: 这是我穿过的最暖和的外套。
words.en: superlative form of warm: having the highest temperature or being the most affectionate or friendly

words.tr:
adj. 凉爽的；酷的；凉的；顶好的；
v. 变凉；
words.ex: The water is cool after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后水很凉爽。
words.en: If you say that a person or their behavior is cool, you mean that they are calm and unemotional, especially in a difficult situation.

words.tr: adj. 更凉的；更凉爽的；更酷的；“cool”的比较级； n. 冷却器；
words.ex: The water in the fridge is cooler than the water outside.
words.ex_cn: 冰箱里的水比外面的水更凉。
words.en: A cooler is a container that keeps things cold, especially food or drinks.

words.tr: adj. 最酷的；最冷静的
words.ex: This is the coolest shirt I have ever seen.
words.ex_cn: 这是我见过的最酷的衬衫。
words.en: Superlative form of 'cool', meaning the most cool or the most calm.

words.tr: adj. 明亮的；鲜艳的；聪明的；
words.ex: The room is bright because of the big window.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间因为大窗户而很明亮。
words.en: Emitting or reflecting much light; shining.

words.tr: adj. 更明亮的（bright的比较级）
words.ex: The room looked brighter with the new curtains.
words.ex_cn: 新窗帘让房间看起来更明亮。
words.en: Comparative form of bright: more bright; emitting or reflecting more light; more intelligent or quick-witted.

words.tr: adj. 最亮的; adv. 最明亮地
words.ex: The brightest star in the night sky is Sirius.
words.ex_cn: 夜空中最亮的星星是天狼星。
words.en: superlative form of bright: emitting or reflecting much light; shining.

words.tr:
adj. 黑暗的；暗色的；深色的；
n. 黑暗；夜；暗色；
words.ex: The room was dark after the power went out.
words.ex_cn: 停电后，房间变得黑暗。
words.en: The absence of light in a place is referred to as dark. It can also describe something that is not light in color, or something that is mysterious or difficult to understand.

words.tr: adj. 更暗的；更黑的；更深的（dark的比较级）
words.ex: The sky became darker after the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴过后，天空变得更暗了。
words.en: Comparative form of dark, meaning having less light or a deeper shade.

words.tr: adj. 最黑暗的
words.ex: This is the darkest night I have ever experienced.
words.ex_cn: 这是我经历过的最黑暗的夜晚。
words.en: Superlative form of dark, meaning the least illuminated or the most lacking in light.

words.tr:
n. 光；灯；光线；
adj. 轻的；浅的；少量的；明亮的；
v. 点燃；照亮；
words.ex: The light from the window brightened the room.
words.ex_cn: 窗户透进来的光让房间变亮了。
words.en: Light is the natural agent that stimulates sight and makes things visible. It is also used to describe something that is not heavy or a source of illumination.

words.tr: adj. 更轻的；更浅的；“light”的比较级；
words.ex: This bag is lighter than the other one.
words.ex_cn: 这个包比另一个更轻。
words.en: A lighter is a device that produces a small flame, used to light cigarettes, cigars, or pipes. It can also refer to a boat used to transport goods between a ship and the shore.

words.tr: adj. 最轻的；最不重的
words.ex: This is the lightest bag I have ever carried.
words.ex_cn: 这是我背过的最轻的包。
words.en: Superlative form of light, meaning having the least weight or brightness.

words.tr: adj. 重的；沉重的；
words.ex: The box is heavy.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子很重。
words.en: Something that is heavy weighs a lot.

words.tr: adj.更沉重的
words.ex: This bag is heavier than that one.
words.ex_cn: 这个包比那个重。
words.en: Comparative form of heavy; having a great weight or density.

words.tr: adj. 重的；巨大的；
words.ex: This box is the heaviest of all.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子是所有箱子里最重的。
words.en: Superlative form of heavy; having the most weight.

words.tr: adj. 瘦的；薄的；
words.ex: He is thin.
words.ex_cn: 他很瘦。
words.en: Having a small distance between opposite sides; not thick.

words.tr: adj. 较薄的；较瘦的；
words.ex: This paper is thinner than that one.
words.ex_cn: 这张纸比那张薄。
words.en: Comparative of thin; having less thickness, width, or density than something else.

words.tr: adj. 薄的，瘦的
words.ex: She wore the thinnest dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿着最薄的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: Superlative form of thin, meaning having the least thickness or the smallest circumference among a group.

words.tr:
n. 脂肪；
adj. 肥的；
words.ex: This food has too much fat.
words.ex_cn: 这种食物含有太多脂肪。
words.en: Fat is a substance contained in foods such as meat, cheese, and butter, which is used by the body to produce energy or stored in the body as a layer.

words.tr: adj. 更胖的；更肥胖的（fat 的比较级）
words.ex: The cat is getting fatter every day.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫每天都在变胖。
words.en: Comparative adjective meaning having more body fat.

words.tr: adj. 最胖的；最肥胖的
words.ex: The fattest cat sleeps on the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 最胖的猫躺在沙发上睡觉。
words.en: Superlative form of fat, meaning having the most body fat or being the thickest.

words.tr: adj. 强壮的；强烈的；
words.ex: He is strong enough to lift the box.
words.ex_cn: 他很强壮，足以举起这个箱子。
words.en: Someone who is strong is healthy with good muscles and can move or carry heavy things, or do hard physical work.

words.tr: adj. 更强壮的；更强烈的；“strong”的比较级；
words.ex: He became stronger after exercising every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天锻炼后变得更强壮了。
words.en: Comparative of strong; having more physical power or higher degree of intensity.

words.tr: adj. 强烈的; 强壮的; 强的( strong的最高级 ); 坚强的
words.ex: He is the strongest man I have ever seen.
words.ex_cn: 他是我见过的最强壮的人。
words.en: Having the greatest power, intensity, or durability; the most robust or effective.

words.tr: adj. 虚弱的；无力的；
words.ex: He feels weak after the long illness.
words.ex_cn: 这场大病之后，他感到虚弱。
words.en: If someone is weak, they are not physically strong or healthy.

words.tr: adj. 虚弱的；无力的；不牢固的；
words.ex: He feels weaker after the long illness.
words.ex_cn: 这场长期疾病后，他感觉更虚弱了。
words.en: Comparative form of 'weak', meaning less strong or less powerful.

words.tr: adj. 最虚弱的；
words.ex: He is the weakest player on the team.
words.ex_cn: 他是队里最虚弱的球员。
words.en: Superlative of weak; least strong or powerful.

words.tr:
adj. 响亮的；大声的；
adv. 大声地；
words.ex: The music was too loud at the party.
words.ex_cn: 派对上的音乐太响了。
words.en: If a noise is loud, the level of sound is very high and it can be easily heard.

words.tr: adj.loud（响亮的，大声的，高声的）的比较级形式
words.ex: Please speak louder; I can't hear you.
words.ex_cn: 请大声点说话，我听不见你。
words.en: At a higher volume or with greater intensity.

words.tr: adj. 最大声的；最响亮的；“loud”的最高级
words.ex: The loudest noise came from the construction site next door.
words.ex_cn: 最响的噪音来自隔壁的建筑工地。
words.en: Superlative form of loud: used to describe the highest degree of sound volume.

words.tr: adj. 安静的
words.ex: The child is quiet during nap time.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在午睡时很安静。
words.en: Making little or no noise; free from disturbance or tumult; tranquil; calm.

words.tr: adj. 安静的；清净的；“quiet”的比较级；
words.ex: The library is quieter than the cafeteria.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆比食堂更安静。
words.en: Making less noise or being less active than usual.

words.tr: adj. 最安静的（quiet 的最高级形式，表示声音最小、最平静的状态）
words.ex: The library is the quietest place in the school.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆是学校里最安静的地方。
words.en: Superlative form of quiet, making the least noise or being the most silent.

words.tr:
adj. 困难的；坚硬的；费劲的；
adv. 努力地；
words.ex: This math problem is hard.
words.ex_cn: 这个数学题很难。
words.en: If something is hard, it is very difficult to do or deal with. It can also mean that something is solid and firm, not soft or liquid.

words.tr:
adj. 更困难的；更硬的；
adv. 更努力地；
words.ex: This math problem is harder than the last one.
words.ex_cn: 这个数学题比上一个更难。
words.en: Harder is the comparative form of hard, meaning more difficult or requiring more effort.

words.tr: adj. 困难的；
words.ex: This math problem is the hardest I have ever seen.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学题是我见过的最难的。
words.en: superlative of hard: most difficult; most solid

words.tr: adj. 软的；柔软的；
words.ex: The pillow is soft and comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 这个枕头很软，很舒服。
words.en: Something that is soft is pleasant to touch, and not rough or hard.

words.tr: adj. 较软的；更温和的；
words.ex: This pillow is softer than the other one.
words.ex_cn: 这个枕头比另一个更软。
words.en: Comparative form of 'soft'; less hard or more gentle.

words.tr: adj. 最柔软的；最温和的；最柔和的
words.ex: This pillow is the softest one I have ever slept on.
words.ex_cn: 这个枕头是我睡过最柔软的。
words.en: Having the least degree of hardness or firmness; the most delicate or gentle.

words.tr:
adj. 洁净的；干净的；
v. 打扫；使干净；
words.ex: The kitchen is clean after she wiped the counters.
words.ex_cn: 她擦了台面后，厨房变得洁净了。
words.en: If something is clean, it is free from dirt, marks, or unwanted substances.

words.tr: n. 清洁工人；清洁工具； adj. 更洁净的；更干净的；“clean”的比较级；
words.ex: The cleaner sweeps the floor every morning.
words.ex_cn: 清洁工人每天早上扫地。
words.en: A cleaner is a person whose job is to clean a place or a substance used for cleaning.

words.tr: adj. 最洁净的；
words.ex: This is the cleanest room in the house.
words.ex_cn: 这是房子里最洁净的房间。
words.en: Superlative form of clean, meaning most free from dirt, marks, or impurities.

words.tr: adj. 肮脏的；
words.ex: The floor is dirty after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 下雨后，地板变得肮脏了。
words.en: If something is dirty, it is marked or covered with stains, spots, or mud, and needs to be cleaned.

words.tr: adj. 更脏的
words.ex: The floor is dirtier than the table.
words.ex_cn: 地板比桌子更脏。
words.en: Comparative of dirty; more dirty.

words.tr: adj. 最脏的
words.ex: This is the dirtiest room I have ever seen.
words.ex_cn: 这是我所见过的最脏的房间。
words.en: Superlative form of 'dirty', meaning the most unclean or soiled.

words.tr: adj. 漂亮的
words.ex: She is a beautiful girl.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个美丽的女孩。
words.en: Pleasing the senses or mind aesthetically.

words.tr: phrase. 更美丽的；更漂亮的
words.ex: This flower is more beautiful than that one.
words.ex_cn: 这朵花比那朵更漂亮。
words.en: Comparative adjective meaning more aesthetically pleasing or attractive.

words.tr: phrase. 最美丽的；最漂亮的；极其美好的
words.ex: She is the most beautiful girl in the class.
words.ex_cn: 她是班上最漂亮的女孩。
words.en: Superlative form of beautiful, meaning having the greatest aesthetic appeal.

words.tr: adj. 丑陋的；难看的；
words.ex: The old house looks ugly with broken windows.
words.ex_cn: 这栋老房子有破窗户，看起来很丑陋。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is ugly, you mean that they are very unattractive and unpleasant to look at.

words.tr: adj. 更难看的；更丑陋的（ugly 的比较级）
words.ex: This shirt is uglier than that one.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫比那件更丑。
words.en: Comparative form of ugly, meaning less attractive than another.

words.tr: adj. 最难看的；最丑陋的（ugly 的最高级形式）
words.ex: That is the ugliest hat I have ever seen.
words.ex_cn: 那是我见过最丑的帽子。
words.en: Superlative form of ugly, meaning the least attractive of all.

words.tr: adj. 聪明的；
words.ex: The clever boy solved the math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这个聪明的男孩很快解决了这道数学题。
words.en: Someone who is clever is intelligent and able to understand things easily or plan things well.

words.tr: phrase. 更聪明的；更机灵的
words.ex: He is cleverer than his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他比他弟弟更聪明。
words.en: Comparative form of clever, meaning more intelligent or skillful than another.

words.tr: phrase. 最聪明的；最机灵的（clever 的最高级形式，cleverest 和 most clever 均表示最高级）
words.ex: He is the cleverest boy in his class.
words.ex_cn: 他是班上最聪明的男孩。
words.en: Superlative form of clever, meaning most intelligent or quick-witted.

words.tr: adj. 愚蠢的；笨的；
words.ex: He made a stupid mistake on the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中犯了一个愚蠢的错误。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is stupid, you mean that they show a lack of good judgment or intelligence and they are not at all sensible.

words.tr: phrase. 更愚蠢的；更傻的（比较级和原级连用，表示程度加深）
words.ex: He is stupider than his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他比他弟弟更傻。
words.en: Comparative form of stupid, meaning less intelligent or more foolish.

words.tr: phrase. 最愚蠢的；最笨的（stupid 的最高级形式）
words.ex: He is the stupidest person I know.
words.ex_cn: 他是我认识的最愚蠢的人。
words.en: Superlative form of stupid, meaning least intelligent or most foolish.

words.tr: adj. 勇敢的；无畏的；
words.ex: The brave firefighter saved the child from the fire.
words.ex_cn: 这位勇敢的消防员从火中救出了孩子。
words.en: Someone who is brave is willing to do things which are dangerous, and does not show fear in difficult or dangerous situations.

words.tr: adj. 勇敢的
words.ex: He is braver than his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他比他弟弟更勇敢。
words.en: showing no fear of dangerous or difficult situations.

words.tr: adj. 最勇敢的（brave 的最高级）
words.ex: He is the bravest man I know.
words.ex_cn: 他是我认识的最勇敢的人。
words.en: Superlative form of brave, meaning most courageous or fearless.

words.tr: adj. 害羞的；胆怯的；
words.ex: The shy boy didn't speak in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个害羞的男孩在课堂上没有说话。
words.en: If you are shy, you are nervous and uncomfortable in the company of other people.

words.tr: 未知词汇，无法提供准确释义
words.ex: He is shyer than his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他比他哥哥更害羞。
words.en: Comparative form of shy, meaning more reserved or timid.

words.tr: adj. 最害羞的；最胆怯的
words.ex: He is the shyest boy in the class.
words.ex_cn: 他是班上最害羞的男孩。
words.en: Superlative form of shy, meaning most reserved or timid.

words.tr: adj. 忙碌的；忙于；
words.ex: He is busy with his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他正忙于做作业。
words.en: If you are busy, you are working hard or giving your attention to a particular activity.

words.tr: adj. 更忙的
words.ex: She is busier this week than last week.
words.ex_cn: 她这周比上周更忙。
words.en: comparative form of busy; having a great deal to do.

words.tr: adj. 最忙的；
words.ex: She is the busiest person in the office.
words.ex_cn: 她是办公室里最忙的人。
words.en: Superlative form of busy: most busy.

words.tr:
adj. 免费的；自由的；
adv. 免费地；自由地；
v. 释放；
words.ex: The museum offers free entry on Sundays.
words.ex_cn: 这个博物馆在周日免费入场。
words.en: If someone is free, they are able to do what they want to do, or go where they want to go, without being controlled or restricted.

words.tr: n. 给予自由的人或事物 adj. 自由的( free的比较级 ); 免费的; 空闲的; 摆脱…的
words.ex: He is freer to choose his own path now.
words.ex_cn: 现在他能更自由地选择自己的道路了。
words.en: Freer is the comparative form of free, meaning more free.

words.tr: adj. 最自由的
words.ex: This is the freest country in the world.
words.ex_cn: 这是世界上最自由的国家。
words.en: Superlative form of 'free', meaning the most free.

words.tr:
adj. 早的；早前的；
adv. 提早地；
words.ex: He woke up early this morning.
words.ex_cn: 他今天早上起得很早。
words.en: Before the usual or expected time; at or near the beginning of a particular period or series of events.

words.tr: adv. 早些时候；“early”的比较级； adj. 之前的；早期的；“early”的比较级；
words.ex: He left the party earlier.
words.ex_cn: 他早些时候离开了派对。
words.en: Before the present time or before the time one is referring to.

words.tr: adj. 最早的；
words.ex: He was the earliest student to arrive at school.
words.ex_cn: 他是最早到校的学生。
words.en: The superlative form of 'early', meaning happening or done before the usual or expected time.

words.tr:
adj. 晚的；迟的；已故的；
adv. 晚；迟；
words.ex: The train is late.
words.ex_cn: 火车晚点了。
words.en: After the expected, usual, or proper time.

words.tr:
adv. 后来；稍后；
adj. 后来的；稍后的；晚些的；晚年的；
words.ex: He left the party, and later he called his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他离开了派对，后来给朋友打了电话。
words.en: Later means after the present time or after the time you are talking about.

words.tr:
adj. 最新的；最后的；最近的；
n. 最新事物；
words.ex: He bought the latest phone on the market.
words.ex_cn: 他买了市场上最新的手机。
words.en: The most recent or the newest.

words.tr: adj. 快的；迅速的；
words.ex: He gave a quick answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对问题给出了一个快速的回答。
words.en: Moving fast or doing something in a short time.

words.tr: adj. 更快的；更迅速的；“quick”的比较级；
words.ex: This car is quicker than the old one.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车比旧车更快。
words.en: More rapid in movement or action than someone or something else.

words.tr: adj. 最快的；最迅速的；
words.ex: He is the quickest runner in the class.
words.ex_cn: 他是班上跑得最快的人。
words.en: Superlative form of quick: moving fast or doing something in a short time.

words.tr:
adj. 深的；
adv. 深深地；
n. 深处；
words.ex: The well is deep.
words.ex_cn: 这口井很深。
words.en: Extending far down from the top or surface; of great vertical extent.

words.tr: adj. 深奥的；深的；严重的；深的( deep的比较级 )；
words.ex: This book has a deeper meaning than it first appears.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的意义比表面上看起来更深奥。
words.en: Extending far down from the top or surface.

words.tr: adj. 最深的，最深
words.ex: The deepest part of the ocean is very dark.
words.ex_cn: 海洋最深的地方非常黑暗。
words.en: The superlative form of 'deep', meaning the most deep.

words.tr: adj. 浅的；
words.ex: The pond is shallow, so you can see the bottom.
words.ex_cn: 这个池塘很浅，所以你能看到底部。
words.en: If something is shallow, it does not extend far down from the top surface.

words.tr: adj. 浅的；浅的( shallow的比较级 )；
words.ex: The water in the pond is shallower than last year.
words.ex_cn: 这个池塘的水比去年浅了。
words.en: Comparative form of shallow; less deep.

words.tr: adj. 最浅的；肤浅的
words.ex: This pool is the shallowest in the neighborhood.
words.ex_cn: 这个泳池是附近最浅的。
words.en: Superlative form of shallow, meaning least deep or superficial.

words.tr:
adj. 广泛的；宽的；宽阔的；
adv. 广大地；
words.ex: The book has wide use in schools.
words.ex_cn: 这本书在学校里被广泛使用。
words.en: Something that is wide measures a large distance from one side to the other.

words.tr: adj. 更宽的；更宽阔的；“wide”的比较级；
words.ex: This road is wider than the last one.
words.ex_cn: 这条路比上一条更宽。
words.en: Comparative form of wide; having a greater extent from side to side.

words.tr: adj. 最宽的
words.ex: This is the widest road in the city.
words.ex_cn: 这是这座城市最宽的路。
words.en: Superlative form of 'wide', meaning having the greatest extent from side to side.

words.tr:
adj. 狭窄的；窄小的；
v. 使窄小；
words.ex: The road is narrow and hard to drive on.
words.ex_cn: 这条路很窄，开车很难。
words.en: If something narrows, or if you narrow it, it becomes less wide.

words.tr: adj. 更窄的；更有限的
words.ex: The path became narrower as we climbed higher.
words.ex_cn: 我们爬得越高，路变得越窄。
words.en: Comparative form of 'narrow', meaning more limited in width or scope.

words.tr: adj. 最窄的
words.ex: This is the narrowest street in the city.
words.ex_cn: 这是城市里最窄的街道。
words.en: The superlative form of 'narrow', meaning the least wide or having the smallest width.

words.tr: adj. 厚的；粗的；浓稠的；
words.ex: The book has a thick cover.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有厚厚的封面。
words.en: Having a large distance between the top and bottom or front and back surfaces; not thin.

words.tr: adj. 厚的；浓的；稠密的；浓的( thick的比较级 )；
words.ex: This book is thicker than that one.
words.ex_cn: 这本书比那本厚。
words.en: Having a greater density or consistency; more substantial.

words.tr: adj. 最厚的；最粗的；最浓的
words.ex: This is the thickest book I have ever read.
words.ex_cn: 这是我读过的最厚的书。
words.en: adj. of the greatest thickness, density, or viscosity among a group of things.

words.tr:
adj. 极好的；大的；伟大的；
adv. 很好地；
words.ex: This is a great movie!
words.ex_cn: 这是一部极好的电影！
words.en: If you describe someone or something as great, you approve of them or admire them.

words.tr: adj. 较大的；程度较重的；
words.ex: This box is greater than that one.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子比那个大。
words.en: You use greater to indicate that something is larger in size, degree, or importance than something else.

words.tr: adj. (数量、规模等）最大的；
words.ex: This is the greatest number of students in our class.
words.ex_cn: 这是我们班人数最多的时候。
words.en: The superlative form of great, used to describe something that is the largest in size, extent, or degree, or the most important or significant.

words.tr: adj. 大的
words.ex: He has a large house.
words.ex_cn: 他有一所大房子。
words.en: Something that is large is greater in size than usual or average.

words.tr: adj. 大的；“large”的比较级；
words.ex: This box is larger than that one.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子比那个大。
words.en: Of considerable or great size or extent.

words.tr: adj. 最大的；
words.ex: This is the largest apple in the basket.
words.ex_cn: 这是篮子里最大的苹果。
words.en: Of considerable or great size or extent.

words.tr: adj. 极小的；微小的；微量的；
words.ex: The tiny ant carried a big leaf.
words.ex_cn: 这只极小的蚂蚁搬着一片大叶子。
words.en: Very small in size or amount.

words.tr: adj. 更小的；更微小的（tiny 的比较级）
words.ex: This bug is tinier than a grain of sand.
words.ex_cn: 这只虫子比一粒沙子还小。
words.en: Comparative form of tiny, meaning smaller or more minute.

words.tr: adj. 最小的；微小的
words.ex: The tiniest ant can carry a big leaf.
words.ex_cn: 最小的蚂蚁也能搬动一片大叶子。
words.en: The smallest or most insignificant in size, amount, or degree.

words.tr: adj. 巨大的
words.ex: The dog is huge.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗很大。
words.en: Extremely large in size or amount.

words.tr: phrase. 极其巨大的；巨大无比的（用于强调程度，非标准用法，可能是 'more huge' 的夸张表达）
words.ex: The elephant is huge.
words.ex_cn: 这头大象非常大。
words.en: Comparative form of huge, meaning larger or more enormous.

words.tr: phrase. 最大的；巨大的（huge 的最高级）
words.ex: That is the hugest building in the city.
words.ex_cn: 那是这座城市最大的建筑。
words.en: Superlative form of huge, meaning largest or most enormous.

words.tr: adj. 重要的
words.ex: It is important to eat healthy food.
words.ex_cn: 吃健康的食物很重要。
words.en: Something that is important is very significant, is highly valued, or is necessary.

words.tr: phrase. 更重要的；更为重要的
words.ex: More important, he finished his homework on time.
words.ex_cn: 更重要的是，他按时完成了作业。
words.en: Comparative form of important; used to indicate that something is of greater significance or value than something else.

words.tr: phrase. 最重要
words.ex: Health is the most important thing in life.
words.ex_cn: 健康是生活中最重要的事情。
words.en: Of the greatest significance or value.

words.tr: adj. 有趣的
words.ex: The book is interesting.
words.ex_cn: 这本书很有趣。
words.en: If something is interesting, it attracts your attention, because it is unusual, exciting, or has lots of ideas.

words.tr: phrase. 更有趣的；更吸引人的；更令人感兴趣的
words.ex: This book is more interesting than the last one.
words.ex_cn: 这本书比上一本更有趣。
words.en: More engaging or captivating than something else.

words.tr: phrase. 最有趣的
words.ex: This is the most interesting book I have ever read.
words.ex_cn: 这是我看过的最有趣的书。
words.en: Superlative form of 'interesting', meaning the most likely to arouse curiosity or hold attention.

words.tr: adj. 无聊的；令人厌倦的； v. “bore”的现在分词；
words.ex: The movie was boring.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影很无聊。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as boring, you mean that they are not interesting and make you feel tired or impatient.

words.tr: phrase. 更无聊的；更乏味的
words.ex: This math class is more boring than last year.
words.ex_cn: 这门数学课比去年更无聊。
words.en: Comparative adjective meaning less interesting or engaging.

words.tr: phrase. 最无聊的；最乏味的；最令人厌倦的
words.ex: Math is the most boring subject for him.
words.ex_cn: 对他来说，数学是最无聊的科目。
words.en: Extremely dull or uninteresting.

words.tr: adj. 令人激动的；使人兴奋的； v. “excite”的现在分词；
words.ex: The football match was exciting.
words.ex_cn: 这场足球赛令人激动。
words.en: If something is exciting, it makes you feel very happy or enthusiastic.

words.tr: phrase. 更令人兴奋的；更刺激的；更激动人心的
words.ex: The new roller coaster is more exciting than the old one.
words.ex_cn: 新的过山车比旧的更令人兴奋。
words.en: Comparative form of 'exciting', meaning causing more excitement or interest.

words.tr: phrase. 最令人兴奋的；最激动人心的
words.ex: This is the most exciting game I have ever seen.
words.ex_cn: 这是我见过的最激动人心的比赛。
words.en: Extremely thrilling or stimulating.

words.tr: adj. 引起疲劳的；累人的； v. “tire”的现在分词；
words.ex: The long walk was tiring.
words.ex_cn: 这次长时间的散步让人感到疲惫。
words.en: If you describe something as tiring, you mean that it makes you tired so that you want to rest or sleep.

words.tr: phrase. 更令人疲惫的；更累人的
words.ex: Running is more tiring than walking.
words.ex_cn: 跑步比走路更累。
words.en: Causing greater fatigue or weariness.

words.tr: phrase. 最令人疲惫的；最累人的
words.ex: Running a marathon is the most tiring thing I have ever done.
words.ex_cn: 跑马拉松是我做过的最累的事情。
words.en: Causing the greatest fatigue or weariness.

words.tr: adj. 令人放松的；轻松的； v. 放松；“relax”的现在分词；
words.ex: The music is relaxing.
words.ex_cn: 这音乐令人放松。
words.en: Making you feel less worried or tense; helping you to rest and become less stiff.

words.tr: phrase. 更令人放松的；更使人轻松的
words.ex: Walking in the park is more relaxing than sitting at home.
words.ex_cn: 在公园散步比待在家里更放松。
words.en: Providing greater ease or calm.

words.tr: phrase. 最令人放松的；最舒缓的
words.ex: Listening to music is the most relaxing thing for her.
words.ex_cn: 听音乐对她来说是最放松的事情。
words.en: Providing the greatest ease or calm.

words.tr: adj. 有用的
words.ex: This tool is useful for solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具对解决数学问题很有用。
words.en: If something is useful, you can use it to do something or to help you in some way.

words.tr: phrase. 更有用的；更实用的；更有帮助的
words.ex: This tool is more useful than the old one.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具比旧的更有用。
words.en: Having greater practical value or benefit.

words.tr: phrase. 最有用的；最实用的；最有帮助的
words.ex: This tool is the most useful for learning English.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具对学习英语最有用。
words.en: Of the highest degree of utility or benefit.

words.tr: adj. 无用的；无效的；
words.ex: This broken phone is useless.
words.ex_cn: 这部坏掉的手机毫无用处。
words.en: If something is useless, it is not able to do what it is supposed to do or is not effective.

words.tr: phrase. 更无用的；更加无效的；更没有价值的
words.ex: This tool is more useless than the old one.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具比旧的更没用。
words.en: Having less practical value or benefit.

words.tr: phrase. 最无用的；最无效的；最没有价值的
words.ex: This tool is the most useless thing I ever bought.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具是我买过最没用的东西。
words.en: Having the least practical value or benefit.

words.tr: adj. 危险的
words.ex: The river is dangerous for children.
words.ex_cn: 这条河对孩子来说很危险。
words.en: If something is dangerous, it is able or likely to hurt or harm you.

words.tr: phrase. 更危险的；更具威胁的
words.ex: This road is more dangerous than the other one.
words.ex_cn: 这条路比另一条路更危险。
words.en: Comparative form of dangerous; posing a greater risk or threat.

words.tr: phrase. 最危险的；最具危害性的
words.ex: The most dangerous animal in this forest is the tiger.
words.ex_cn: 这个森林里最危险的动物是老虎。
words.en: Causing the greatest risk or harm.

words.tr: adj. 安全的
words.ex: The children are playing in a safe park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在安全的公园里玩耍。
words.en: If something or someone is safe, they are not in danger or likely to be harmed.

words.tr: adj. 更安全的；“safe”的比较级；
words.ex: Wearing a helmet makes riding a bike safer.
words.ex_cn: 戴头盔让骑自行车更安全。
words.en: comparative form of 'safe', meaning more protected from or not exposed to danger or risk; not likely to be harmed or lost.

words.tr: adj. 最安全的
words.ex: This is the safest place to play.
words.ex_cn: 这是最安全的玩耍地方。
words.en: Superlative form of 'safe', meaning the most secure or free from danger.

words.tr:
n. 种类；
adj. 善良的；和蔼的；
words.ex: There are many kinds of fruits in the market.
words.ex_cn: 市场上有各种各样的水果。
words.en: If you describe someone as kind, you mean that they are gentle, caring, and helpful.

words.tr: adj. 较慈祥的; 较体贴的; 较友好的; 较宽容的
words.ex: He is kinder to his little brother now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在对弟弟更友善了。
words.en: comparative of kind; more kind.

words.tr: adj. 最仁慈的；最友善的；最体贴的
words.ex: She is the kindest person I know.
words.ex_cn: 她是我知道的最善良的人。
words.en: Characterized by the greatest kindness; most benevolent and considerate.

words.tr: adj. 残酷的；
words.ex: The cruel king punished the innocent people.
words.ex_cn: 残酷的国王惩罚了无辜的人。
words.en: Someone who is cruel deliberately causes pain or distress to others or feels no concern about it.

words.tr: phrase. 更残忍的，更加残酷的
words.ex: The crueler boy laughed at the crying child.
words.ex_cn: 更残忍的那个男孩嘲笑那个哭泣的孩子。
words.en: Comparative form of cruel; more unkind or causing more suffering.

words.tr: phrase. 最残忍的；最冷酷的
words.ex: He was the cruelest boy in the class.
words.ex_cn: 他是班上最残忍的男孩。
words.en: Superlative form of cruel; the most unkind or causing the most suffering.

words.tr: adj. 有礼貌的；
words.ex: He is polite to everyone he meets.
words.ex_cn: 他对遇到的每个人都很有礼貌。
words.en: Having or showing behavior that is respectful and considerate of other people.

words.tr: phrase. 更有礼貌的；更客气的
words.ex: He spoke politer to his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他跟老师说话更礼貌了。
words.en: Comparative form of polite; more courteous and well-mannered.

words.tr: phrase. 最有礼貌的；最客气的（polite 的最高级）
words.ex: He is the politest person I know.
words.ex_cn: 他是我认识的最有礼貌的人。
words.en: Superlative form of polite; the most courteous and well-mannered.

words.tr: adj. 粗鲁的；无礼的
words.ex: He was rude to the waiter.
words.ex_cn: 他对服务员很无礼。
words.en: If someone is rude, they behave in a way that is not polite and upsets other people.

words.tr: adj. rude的比较级; 粗鲁的( rude的比较级 ); 简陋的; 狂暴的; 近乎下流的
words.ex: He became ruder after he got angry.
words.ex_cn: 他生气后变得更粗鲁了。
words.en: If someone is rude, they behave in a way that is not polite and upsets other people.

words.tr: adj. 最粗鲁的
words.ex: He was the rudest person I had ever met.
words.ex_cn: 他是我见过的最粗鲁的人。
words.en: Superlative form of 'rude', meaning the most impolite or discourteous.

words.tr: adj. 友好的
words.ex: He is a friendly boy who smiles at everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个友好的男孩，对每个人都微笑。
words.en: If someone is friendly, they behave in a pleasant, kind way, and like to be with other people.

words.tr: adj. 友好的；亲切的；友善的（注：正确拼写应为 'friendly'）
words.ex: He is friendlie to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他对每个人都友好。
words.en: Comparative form of friendly; more kind and pleasant.

words.tr: phrase. 更友好的；更友善的；更亲切的
words.ex: He is more friendly than before.
words.ex_cn: 他比以前更友好了。
words.en: Superlative form of friendly; the most kind and pleasant.

words.tr: adj. 最友好的；最亲切的
words.ex: He is the friendliest person in our class.
words.ex_cn: 他是我们班最友好的人。
words.en: Superlative form of friendly; the most kind and pleasant.

words.tr: phrase. 最友好的；最友善的；最亲切的
words.ex: He is the most friendly person in our class.
words.ex_cn: 他是我们班最友好的人。
words.en: Comparative form of lovely; more beautiful or pleasing.

words.tr: adj. 可爱的；美丽的；
words.ex: The little girl has a lovely smile.
words.ex_cn: 这个小女孩有一个可爱的笑容。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as lovely, you mean that they are very beautiful and therefore pleasing to look at or be with.

words.tr: adj. 更可爱的；更美丽的（love的比较级）
words.ex: This flower is lovelier than that one.
words.ex_cn: 这朵花比那朵更漂亮。
words.en: Superlative form of lovely; the most beautiful or pleasing.

words.tr: adj. 最可爱的；最美丽的（love的最高级形式）
words.ex: This is the loveliest flower I have ever seen.
words.ex_cn: 这是我见过的最美丽的花。
words.en: Superlative form of 'lovely'; most beautiful or charming.

words.tr: adj. 孤独的；寂寞的；偏僻的；
words.ex: He felt lonely after his dog died.
words.ex_cn: 他的狗去世后，他感到孤独。
words.en: If you are lonely, you are unhappy because you are alone or do not have anyone you can talk to.

words.tr: adj. 更孤独的；更寂寞的
words.ex: He feels lonelier after his dog passed away.
words.ex_cn: 他的狗去世后，他感觉更孤独了。
words.en: Comparative form of 'lonely'; feeling more isolated or solitary.

words.tr: adj. 最孤独的
words.ex: He felt the loneliest when he was alone at night.
words.ex_cn: 当他晚上独自一人时，他感到最孤独。
words.en: Superlative form of 'lonely', meaning the most isolated or without companionship.

words.tr:
adj. 满的；充满的；
adv. 完全地；
words.ex: The glass is full of water.
words.ex_cn: 这个玻璃杯装满了水。
words.en: Containing or holding as much or as many as possible; having no empty space.

words.tr: adj. 充分的；“full”的比较级；
words.ex: He gave a fuller explanation than before.
words.ex_cn: 他给出了比之前更充分的解释。
words.en: More complete or containing more information.

words.tr: adj. 最满的；最完整的
words.ex: He gave the fullest attention to his work.
words.ex_cn: 他全神贯注于他的工作。
words.en: adj. To the greatest degree or extent; complete.

words.tr:
adj. 空的；无意义的；
v. 倒空；
words.ex: The box is empty.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子是空的。
words.en: If you describe a place, object, or person as empty, you mean that they contain nothing or have no special qualities, and are therefore not interesting or useful.

words.tr: adj. 更空的（empty 的比较级）
words.ex: This bottle is emptier than that one.
words.ex_cn: 这个瓶子比那个更空。
words.en: Comparative form of 'empty', meaning having less or no contents.

words.tr: adj. 最空的；最荒凉的；最贫瘠的
words.ex: The emptiest room had no furniture.
words.ex_cn: 最空的房间没有家具。
words.en: Superlative form of 'empty'; containing the least amount of substance or people.

words.tr: adj. 不同的
words.ex: The two apples are different.
words.ex_cn: 这两个苹果不一样。
words.en: not the same as another or each other; unlike in nature, form, or quality

words.tr: phrase. 更加不同的；差异更大的
words.ex: This apple is more different than that one.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果比那个更不一样。
words.en: Comparative form of 'different'; more unlike or distinct in nature.

words.tr: phrase. 最不同的；差异最大的
words.ex: These two birds are the most different in color.
words.ex_cn: 这两种鸟在颜色上最不同。
words.en: Superlative form of 'different'; most unlike or distinct in nature.

words.tr: adj. 有吸引力的
words.ex: She is an attractive woman.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个有吸引力的女性。
words.en: An attractive person or thing is pleasing or appealing to look at.

words.tr: phrase. 更有吸引力的；更迷人的；更引人注目的
words.ex: She became more attractive after losing weight.
words.ex_cn: 她减肥后变得更加有魅力了。
words.en: More pleasing or attractive than something else.

words.tr: phrase. 最具吸引力的；最迷人的；最诱人的
words.ex: She is the most attractive girl in the class.
words.ex_cn: 她是班上最有吸引力的女生。
words.en: Superlative form of 'attractive'; most appealing or pleasing in appearance.

words.tr: adj. 舒适的；安逸的；
words.ex: This chair is very comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子非常舒适。
words.en: If a piece of furniture or an item of clothing is comfortable, it makes you feel physically relaxed when you use it or wear it, for example because it is soft.

words.tr: phrase. 更舒适的；更惬意的；更放松的
words.ex: This chair is more comfortable than that one.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子比那把更舒服。
words.en: Comparative form of 'comfortable'; providing more ease or relaxation.

words.tr: phrase. 最舒适的；最惬意的；最自在的
words.ex: This chair is the most comfortable in the room.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子是房间里最舒服的。
words.en: Superlative form of 'comfortable'; providing the greatest ease or relaxation.

words.tr: adj. 便利的；方便的；
words.ex: This store is convenient for buying groceries.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店买杂货很方便。
words.en: If something is convenient, it is easy to use or do, or it is useful and suitable for a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 更方便的；更便利的；更合宜的
words.ex: This app is more convenient than the old one.
words.ex_cn: 这个应用比旧的更方便。
words.en: Requiring less effort or time; easier or more suitable for one's needs.

words.tr: phrase. 最方便的；最便利的；最合宜的
words.ex: This bus is the most convenient way to get to school.
words.ex_cn: 这趟公交车是去学校最方便的方式。
words.en: Superlative form of 'convenient'; most suitable or easy to use.

words.tr: adj. 令人愉快的；令人高兴的
words.ex: The garden is delightful in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天时，这个花园令人愉快。
words.en: Something that is delightful is very pleasant, attractive, or enjoyable.

words.tr: phrase. 更令人愉快的；更加令人高兴的
words.ex: The flowers are more delightful this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年的花更令人愉快了。
words.en: Comparative form of 'delightful'; more pleasing or enjoyable.

words.tr: phrase. 最令人愉快的；极其讨人喜欢的
words.ex: The most delightful gift was a flower from her son.
words.ex_cn: 最令人愉快的礼物是她儿子送的一朵花。
words.en: Extremely pleasing and enjoyable.

words.tr: adj. 效率高的
words.ex: He uses an efficient way to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用一种高效的方法解决数学问题。
words.en: If something or someone is efficient, they are able to do tasks successfully, without wasting time or energy.

words.tr: phrase. 更高效的；更有效的
words.ex: This machine is more efficient than the old one.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器比旧的更高效。
words.en: Achieving maximum productivity with minimum wasted effort or expense.

words.tr: phrase. 最有效的；效率最高的
words.ex: This method is the most efficient.
words.ex_cn: 这种方法是最有效的。
words.en: Achieving maximum productivity with minimum wasted effort or expense.

words.tr: adj. 优雅的；
words.ex: She wore an elegant dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条优雅的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe a person or thing as elegant, you mean that they are pleasing and graceful in appearance or style.

words.tr: phrase. 更优雅的；更高雅的；更雅致的；更讲究的
words.ex: This solution is more elegant than the other one.
words.ex_cn: 这个解法比另一个更优雅。
words.en: More graceful and stylish in appearance or manner.

words.tr: phrase. 最优雅的；最雅致的；最高雅的；最简洁优美的
words.ex: This solution is the most elegant.
words.ex_cn: 这个解法是最优雅的。
words.en: Extremely graceful and stylish in appearance or manner.

words.tr: adj. 巨大的；大量的；
words.ex: The elephant is enormous.
words.ex_cn: 这头大象非常巨大。
words.en: If you describe something as enormous, you are emphasizing that it is extremely large in size or amount.

words.tr: phrase. 更加巨大的；更为庞大的
words.ex: The elephant is more enormous than the horse.
words.ex_cn: 这头大象比马更大。
words.en: Larger or more impressive in size or scale.

words.tr: phrase. 极其巨大的；最大规模的
words.ex: He saw the most enormous elephant at the zoo.
words.ex_cn: 他在动物园里看到了最大的大象。
words.en: Extremely large or impressive in size or scale.

words.tr: adj. 慷慨的；大方的；
words.ex: He gave a generous donation to the poor.
words.ex_cn: 他慷慨地捐钱给穷人。
words.en: A generous person gives more of something, especially money, than is usual or expected.

words.tr: phrase. 更大方的；更慷慨的；更宽厚的；更丰富的
words.ex: He is more generous with his time than his money.
words.ex_cn: 他比花钱更愿意花时间。
words.en: More willing to give money, help, or kindness than is usual or expected.

words.tr: phrase. 最慷慨的；最大方的；最宽厚的；最丰盛的
words.ex: He is the most generous person I know.
words.ex_cn: 他是我认识的最慷慨的人。
words.en: Extremely willing to give money, help, or kindness.

words.tr: adj. 和谐的；
words.ex: The team worked in a harmonious way.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队以和谐的方式合作。
words.en: A harmonious situation, relationship, or agreement is one in which people are friendly and helpful to one another, and in which there is no serious disagreement or argument.

words.tr: phrase. 更加和谐的；更加协调的；更加融洽的
words.ex: They live in a more harmonious neighborhood now.
words.ex_cn: 他们现在住在一个更加和谐的社区里。
words.en: More pleasing in the sound of different notes played together.

words.tr: phrase. 最和谐的；最协调的；最融洽的
words.ex: This song is the most harmonious I have ever heard.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌是我听过的最和谐的。
words.en: Extremely pleasing in the sound of different notes played together.

words.tr: adj. 有帮助的；
words.ex: This book is helpful for learning English.
words.ex_cn: 这本书对学习英语有帮助。
words.en: If you describe someone as helpful, you mean that they help you in some way, such as doing part of your job for you or by giving you advice or information.

words.tr: phrase. 更有帮助的；更有益的；更有用的
words.ex: This app is more helpful than my textbook.
words.ex_cn: 这个应用比我的教科书更有帮助。
words.en: More helpful: Comparative form of 'helpful'; providing greater assistance or benefit.

words.tr: phrase. 最有帮助的；最有用的；最有助益的
words.ex: This book is the most helpful for learning English.
words.ex_cn: 这本书对学习英语最有帮助。
words.en: Most helpful: Superlative form of 'helpful'; providing the greatest assistance or benefit.

words.tr: adj. 绝望的
words.ex: He felt hopeless after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到毫无希望。
words.en: If you feel hopeless, you feel very unhappy because there seems to be no possibility of a better situation or success.

words.tr: phrase. 更加绝望的；更无望的；更无可救药的
words.ex: He felt more hopeless after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到更加绝望。
words.en: More hopeless: Comparative form of 'hopeless'; having less hope or being more despairing.

words.tr: phrase. 最绝望的；最无望的；最无可救药的
words.ex: He is the most hopeless student in class.
words.ex_cn: 他是班上最没希望的学生。
words.en: Most hopeless: Superlative form of 'hopeless'; having the least hope or being the most despairing.

words.tr: adj. 令人印象深刻的；
words.ex: His speech was very impressive.
words.ex_cn: 他的演讲非常令人印象深刻。
words.en: Something that is impressive makes you admire it because it is very good, large, important, etc.

words.tr: phrase. 更令人印象深刻的；更给人深刻印象的
words.ex: His new painting is more impressive than the last one.
words.ex_cn: 他的新画比上一幅更令人印象深刻。
words.en: More impressive: Comparative form of 'impressive'; causing greater admiration or awe.

words.tr: phrase. 最令人印象深刻的；最感人的；最震撼的
words.ex: His most impressive skill is solving math problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他最令人印象深刻的能力是快速解决数学问题。
words.en: Most impressive: Superlative form of 'impressive'; causing the greatest admiration or awe.

words.tr: adj. 独立的；自主的；
words.ex: He lives independently and makes his own decisions.
words.ex_cn: 他独立生活，并自己做决定。
words.en: If one thing or person is independent of another, they are separate and not connected, so that the first one is not affected or influenced by the second.

words.tr: phrase. 更加独立的
words.ex: She became more independent after moving to the city.
words.ex_cn: 搬到城市后，她变得更加独立了。
words.en: Not influenced or controlled by others in matters of opinion, conduct, etc.; thinking or acting for oneself.

words.tr: phrase. 最独立的；最自主的；最不受他人影响的
words.ex: He is the most independent student in the class.
words.ex_cn: 他是班上最独立的学生。
words.en: Most independent: Superlative form of 'independent'; not reliant on others to the greatest degree.

words.tr: adj. 有才智的；聪明的；明智的；
words.ex: The intelligent boy solved the math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这个有才智的男孩很快解出了这道数学题。
words.en: Someone who is intelligent has the ability to think, understand, and learn things quickly and well.

words.tr: phrase. 更聪明的；更有才智的；智力更高的
words.ex: He is more intelligent than his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他比他哥哥更聪明。
words.en: More intelligent: Comparative form of 'intelligent'; having greater mental capacity or understanding.

words.tr: phrase. 最聪明的；最智能的；最具智慧的
words.ex: He is the most intelligent student in the class.
words.ex_cn: 他是班上最聪明的学生。
words.en: Most intelligent: Superlative form of 'intelligent'; having the greatest mental capacity or understanding.

words.tr: adj. 值得纪念的；难忘的；
words.ex: That vacation was a memorable trip.
words.ex_cn: 那次旅行是一次值得纪念的旅程。
words.en: Something that is memorable is worth remembering or likely to be remembered, because it is special or very enjoyable.

words.tr: phrase. 更令人难忘的；更难忘的；更印象深刻的
words.ex: This song is more memorable than the other one.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌比另一首更令人难忘。
words.en: More memorable: Comparative form of 'memorable'; easier to remember or more worth remembering.

words.tr: phrase. 最难忘的
words.ex: That trip was the most memorable day of my life.
words.ex_cn: 那次旅行是我一生中最难忘的一天。
words.en: The phrase 'most memorable' is used to describe something that is extremely likely to be remembered due to its significant impact or importance.

words.tr: adj. 神秘的
words.ex: The mysterious box appeared on his doorstep.
words.ex_cn: 那个神秘的盒子出现在他的门口。
words.en: If someone or something is mysterious, it is not fully understood or explained and seems interesting or puzzling.

words.tr: phrase. 更加神秘的；更难以理解的；更诡秘的
words.ex: The forest looks more mysterious at night.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚时，这片森林显得更加神秘。
words.en: More mysterious: Comparative form of mysterious; more puzzling or enigmatic.

words.tr: phrase. 最神秘的；最难以理解的；最不可思议的
words.ex: The most mysterious thing is the old house at night.
words.ex_cn: 最神秘的是夜晚那座老房子。
words.en: Most mysterious: Superlative form of mysterious; the most puzzling or enigmatic.

words.tr: adj. 必需的；必要的；必然的；
words.ex: Water is necessary for life.
words.ex_cn: 水是生命所必需的。
words.en: If something is necessary, it is needed in order for something else to happen or be done.

words.tr: phrase. 更加必要的；更为必需的
words.ex: Water is more necessary than candy for survival.
words.ex_cn: 水比糖果对生存更重要。
words.en: More necessary: Comparative form of necessary; more essential or required.

words.tr: phrase. 最必要的；绝对必需的；至关重要的
words.ex: Water is the most necessary thing for life.
words.ex_cn: 水是生命中最必要的东西。
words.en: Most necessary: Superlative form of necessary; the most essential or required.

words.tr: adj. 显而易见的；
words.ex: The change in her mood was noticeable.
words.ex_cn: 她情绪的变化显而易见。
words.en: Something that is noticeable is very obvious, so that it is easy to see, hear, or recognize.

words.tr: phrase. 更明显的；更显著的；更容易被注意到的
words.ex: The color is more noticeable in sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 这种颜色在阳光下更显眼。
words.en: More noticeable: Comparative form of noticeable; more easily seen or observed.

words.tr: phrase. 最显著的；最引人注目的；最明显的
words.ex: The most noticeable change is the new color of the wall.
words.ex_cn: 最明显的变化是墙的新颜色。
words.en: Most noticeable: Superlative form of noticeable; the most easily seen or observed.

words.tr: adj. 普通的；平常的；一般的；
words.ex: He wore an ordinary shirt to school.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一件普通的衬衫去学校。
words.en: Something that is ordinary is not special or different in any way.

words.tr: phrase. 更普通的；更平凡的；更寻常的
words.ex: He wears more ordinary clothes than his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他穿的衣服比他哥哥更普通。
words.en: More ordinary: Comparative form of ordinary; more common or unremarkable.

words.tr: phrase. 最普通的；最平凡的；最常见的
words.ex: He is the most ordinary student in the class.
words.ex_cn: 他是班上最普通的学生。
words.en: Most ordinary: Superlative form of ordinary; the most common or unremarkable.

words.tr: adj. 宁静的；和平的；
words.ex: The lake is peaceful in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 清晨的湖面很宁静。
words.en: If a time, place, or situation is peaceful, it is quiet and calm, with no violence or trouble.

words.tr: phrase. 更和平的；更安宁的；更平静的
words.ex: The village is more peaceful than the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄比城市更宁静。
words.en: More peaceful: Comparative form of peaceful; more calm or free from disturbance.

words.tr: phrase. 最宁静的；最和平的；最安宁的
words.ex: She lives in the most peaceful town.
words.ex_cn: 她住在最宁静的小镇。
words.en: Most peaceful: Superlative form of peaceful; the most calm or free from disturbance.

words.tr: adj. 强有力的；有影响力的；很有效的；
words.ex: He is a powerful speaker who inspires many.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位强有力的演讲者，激励了很多人。
words.en: A powerful person or thing is able to control or influence people or events.

words.tr: phrase. 更强大的；更有力的；影响力更大的
words.ex: This new phone is more powerful than the old one.
words.ex_cn: 这部新手机比旧的更强大。
words.en: Having greater strength, influence, or capability than something else.

words.tr: phrase. 最强大的；最有影响力的；权力最大的
words.ex: He is the most powerful player on the team.
words.ex_cn: 他是队里最有实力的球员。
words.en: Having the greatest strength, influence, or capability of all.

words.tr: adj. 实用的；实际的；实践的；
words.ex: This tool is practical for everyday use.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具日常使用很实用。
words.en: relating to what is real rather than to what is possible or imagined; likely to succeed or be effective in real circumstances; involving or concerned with experience or actual use; not theoretical

words.tr: phrase. 更实用的；更实际的；更具可操作性的
words.ex: This course is more practical than the other one.
words.ex_cn: 这门课程比另一门更实用。
words.en: More useful, effective, or suitable for a particular purpose than something else.

words.tr: phrase. 最实用的；最切合实际的；最具可操作性的
words.ex: This method is the most practical for beginners.
words.ex_cn: 这种方法对初学者来说最实用。
words.en: The most useful, effective, or suitable for a particular purpose of all.

words.tr: adj. 珍贵的；宝贵的；
words.ex: This necklace is precious to her.
words.ex_cn: 这条项链对她来说很珍贵。
words.en: If you say that something such as a resource is precious, you mean that it is valuable and should not be wasted or used badly.

words.tr: phrase. 更珍贵的；更宝贵的；更珍爱的
words.ex: Her smile is more precious than gold.
words.ex_cn: 她的微笑比黄金更珍贵。
words.en: More highly valued, cherished, or important than something else.

words.tr: phrase. 最珍贵的；最宝贵的；最珍爱的
words.ex: Her smile is the most precious thing to him.
words.ex_cn: 她的微笑是他最珍贵的东西。
words.en: The most highly valued, cherished, or important of all.

words.tr:
adj. 专业的；职业的；
n. 专业人士；
words.ex: He is a professional teacher with many years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有多年经验的专业教师。
words.en: A professional is a person who has a job that requires special training and education, especially one that involves a high level of skill or knowledge.

words.tr: phrase. 更专业的；更具职业水准的；更内行的
words.ex: He works more professional now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在工作更专业了。
words.en: More skilled, expert, or businesslike than something else.

words.tr: phrase. 最专业的；最具专业水准的；最符合职业标准的
words.ex: He is the most professional teacher I have ever met.
words.ex_cn: 他是我见过的最专业的老师。
words.en: The most skilled, expert, or businesslike of all.

words.tr: adj. 有责任的；负责任的；
words.ex: He is responsible for cleaning the room.
words.ex_cn: 他负责打扫房间。
words.en: If someone or something is responsible for a particular event or situation, they are the cause of it or they can be blamed for it.

words.tr: phrase. 更有责任感的；更可靠的；更负责任的
words.ex: He is more responsible now than last year.
words.ex_cn: 他现在比去年更负责任了。
words.en: More accountable or trustworthy in one's actions or duties.

words.tr: phrase. 最有责任感的；最负责的；承担最大责任的
words.ex: He is the most responsible person in the team.
words.ex_cn: 他是团队中最负责任的人。
words.en: The most accountable, trustworthy, or having the greatest sense of duty of all.

words.tr: adj. 重大的；重要的；影响明显的；
words.ex: This discovery is a significant step forward.
words.ex_cn: 这一发现是一个重大的进步。
words.en: Something that is significant is important or large enough to be noticed or to have an effect.

words.tr: phrase. 更重要的；更具意义的；更显著的
words.ex: This result is more significant than the last one.
words.ex_cn: 这个结果比上一个更重要。
words.en: More important or impactful than something else.

words.tr: phrase. 最重要的；最有意义的；最显著的
words.ex: This is the most significant change in ten years.
words.ex_cn: 这是十年来最重要的变化。
words.en: The most important, notable, or impactful of all.

words.tr: adj. 成功的；
words.ex: He is a successful businessman.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位成功的商人。
words.en: Achieving the results wanted or hoped for.

words.tr: phrase. 更成功的；更受欢迎的；更有成就的
words.ex: He is more successful than his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他比他哥哥更成功。
words.en: Achieving a higher level of success or better results than before or than others.

words.tr: phrase. 最成功的
words.ex: She is the most successful entrepreneur in the industry.
words.ex_cn: 她是该行业中最成功的企业家。
words.en: Superlative form of 'successful', meaning having achieved the highest level of success or effectiveness.

words.tr: adj. 可怕的；极坏的；糟糕的；
words.ex: The storm caused a terrible flood.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴引发了一场可怕的洪水。
words.en: If something is terrible, it is very bad or of very poor quality.

words.tr: phrase. 更可怕的；更糟糕透顶的；更严重的
words.ex: The storm was more terrible than last year.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴比去年更可怕。
words.en: Worse or more frightening than something else.

words.tr: phrase. 最可怕的；最糟糕的；极其恐怖的
words.ex: That was the most terrible storm I have ever seen.
words.ex_cn: 那是我见过的最可怕的风暴。
words.en: The worst or most frightening of all.

words.tr: adj. 有价值的；贵重的；值钱的；
words.ex: This old book is valuable to historians.
words.ex_cn: 这本旧书对历史学家来说很有价值。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as valuable, you mean that they are very useful and helpful.

words.tr: phrase. 更有价值的；更宝贵的；更重要的
words.ex: This book is more valuable than that one.
words.ex_cn: 这本书比那本更有价值。
words.en: Having a higher worth or importance than something else.

words.tr: phrase. 最有价值的；最宝贵的；最重要的
words.ex: This book is the most valuable thing I own.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是我拥有的最有价值的东西。
words.en: Having the highest worth or importance of all.

words.tr: adj. 各种各样的；不同的；各种的；
words.ex: He bought various fruits at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了各种各样的水果。
words.en: If you say that there are various things, you mean there are several different things of the type mentioned.

words.tr: phrase. 更加多种多样的；更为不同的；更丰富多彩的
words.ex: She has more various books than her brother.
words.ex_cn: 她拥有的书比她哥哥的更多样。
words.en: Having a greater variety or diversity than something else.

words.tr: phrase. 最多样化的；最多种多样的；极其不同的
words.ex: He collects most various stamps from different countries.
words.ex_cn: 他收集来自不同国家的多种多样的邮票。
words.en: Having the greatest variety or diversity of all.

words.tr:
adj. 晚的；迟的；已故的；
adv. 晚；迟；
words.ex: The train is late.
words.ex_cn: 火车晚点了。
words.en: After the expected, usual, or proper time.

words.tr:
adv. 后来；稍后；
adj. 后来的；稍后的；晚些的；晚年的；
words.ex: He left the party, and later he called his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他离开了派对，后来给朋友打了电话。
words.en: Later means after the present time or after the time you are talking about.

words.tr:
n. 后者（the ~）；
adj. 后期的；后面的；
words.ex: I like tea and coffee; I prefer the latter.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢茶和咖啡；我更喜欢后者。
words.en: The latter is used to refer to the second of two things or people mentioned.

words.tr:
adj. 最新的；最后的；最近的；
n. 最新事物；
words.ex: He bought the latest phone on the market.
words.ex_cn: 他买了市场上最新的手机。
words.en: The most recent or the newest.

words.tr:
adj. 最后的；最近的；
v. 持续；
adv. 最后；最近一次；
words.ex: This is the last chance to pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 这是通过考试的最后机会。
words.en: Coming after all others in time or order; final.
